snippet.title: BLOW-UP: Avenge Humanity Teaser
snippet.description:
💥 Wishlist now on Steam! 💥 And don't forget to play the demo 😉
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2301940/BLOWUP_AVENGE_HUMANITY

BLOW-UP: AVENGE HUMANITY is a single-player fast paced boomer shooter where you take control of an industrial robot rewired by the last human being to violently dispatch the alien race that destroyed the Earth. Are you ready to become the ultimate avenger? 

More info: https://halfsunkgames.com/

🎬 Check out the Official Trailer by SaimizZ: https://simonas-macas.com/
🎶 Music & Sound by Jordi Prieto
